role: XCTest suite for the strap connection lifecycle through StrapLinkCoordinator.apply: what a BLE drop preserves (identity while streaming, on-device recording) and clears (live readings, readiness, link tasks), drops for other devices / duplicate drops, lost pairing, reconnect window, link restoration counting, explicit disconnect/cancel/reconnect no-ops, feature readiness and waiters, not-ready retry, live HR ingestion, and stalled-feed health evaluation.
types: PolarConnectionLifecycleTests: class — @MainActor XCTestCase over PolarManager / StrapLinkCoordinator / StrapReadiness

flags.text: The linkedManager doc says managers are 'built without the pairing store so tests do not write to the shared App Group defaults', but PolarManager.init() calls loadKnownDevices()/loadLastConnectedTime(), which read SharedUserDefaults.appGroup and can migrate legacy keys from standard defaults into it; tests therefore start from the host's saved straps (testReconnectingWithNoKnownDeviceDoesNotEnterConnecting has to reset knownDevices by hand).

reads: ud:knownDevices / lastConnectedTime (SharedUserDefaults.appGroup, read by PolarManager.init → StrapPairingStore.load)
